description_en: Modifies an entity value. This applies to entity values that use synonyms or regular expressions. Note: You cannot add a regular expression to a standard entity, and vice versa
description_zh: 修改某个实体的某个实体成员，有实体值&同义词、正则表达式两类数据修改。注意：往一个标准实体中添加正则表达式是不被允许的，反之亦然
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot update-ds-entity-value --instance-id chatbot-cn-yjzbyrEvqd --entity-id 223423423 --entity-value-id 2342377423 --content '书本类型' --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDSEntityValue

parameters.help_en: The key for the business space. If you omit this parameter, the default business space is used. You can find this key on the Business Management page of your primary account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: The entity ID. You can leave this parameter empty when modifying an entity value
parameters.help_zh: 实体ID，修改实体成员时可为空
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity value to update
parameters.help_zh: 实体成员ID，创建实体成员时为空
parameters.name: entity_value_id

parameters.help_en: The new content for the entity value. For an entity type of `synonyms`, this is the normalized value. For an entity type of `regex`, this is the regular expression
parameters.help_zh: 实体类型为synonyms时，表示实体归一化值；当实体类型为regex时，表示正则表达式文本
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The synonym list for the normalized value
parameters.name: synonyms

EntityValueId.description_en: The ID of the updated entity value
